hypothesis: Symmetric-tree boosting and its ordered-gradient variant may generalize beyond the selected asymmetric HGB on the same observed inputs. This experiment changes the learning algorithm, not the information horizon.
limits: Both seasons and previous scores were exposed; no pristine holdout claim.
No new gap or telemetry features, stream latency variants or current-event odds are added.
MAE targets retain reference residual clipping; this is not unconstrained population-median estimation.
SymmetricTree has no equivalent to HGB minimum leaf count80; regularization and capacity differ.
has_time=False permutes within the training season only; no selection labels are supplied to fitting.
Selecting the best of two variants does not independently identify ordered-boosting causality.
No paid compute, provider acquisition, foundation-model checkpoint or policy-value claim.
